NoveltyImplication: Foundational CSP formulation. Solved sequence design via 12A distance graph GNN, but predated AlphaFold2 and modern MPNNs.
Demonstrates ensembling ProteinSolver with language models (ProtBert) for mutation stability prediction (ddG), but not de novo inverse folding or diversity optimization.
Establishes state-of-the-art autoregressive MPNN. Demonstrates that 3D coordinate-invariant features outperform distance-only graphs on sequence recovery. Low diversity at low sampling temperatures.
Demonstrates that scaling inverse folding on millions of AlphaFold structures yields strong zero-shot representations, but requires large compute footprint.
Demonstrates that non-autoregressive GNNs with multi-scale residue featurization can match ProteinMPNN recovery with high inference speed.
Direct independent benchmark of ProteinSolver vs ProteinMPNN and other models. Proves ProteinSolver has lower AAR (33% vs 51%) but distinct diversity profile. Does not combine or ensemble them.

Demonstrates inference-time weighted ensembling between ProteinMPNN and IgLM language model for antibodies. Shows logit combination is feasible and effective, but did not use ProteinSolver or general diversity frameworks.
Establishes the canonical modern pipeline (RFdiffusion + ProteinMPNN + AF2). Proves that structure-conditioned design + AF2 validation works, but reveals need for greater candidate diversity.

Introduces diversity-aware inverse folding via online RL with embedding regularization and multi-objective rewards (scRMSD + ddG). Proves diversity optimization is a critical open challenge, but uses costly RL rather than test-time ensembling.

Establishes Quality-Diversity (MAP-Elites) with gradient emitters for protein sequence spaces. Demonstrates Pareto-like quality-diversity archives, but evaluated on 1D fitness landscapes, not 3D inverse folding.
Open-source structure predictor providing an accessible validation oracle to replace AlphaFold3 web servers.
Expands ProteinMPNN to non-protein contexts (small molecules, nucleic acids), emphasizing atomic precision over diversity-aware sampling.

PROVISIONAL RESEARCH EXTENSION: Evaluates whether ProteinSolver CSP scores complement ProteinMPNN in a post-hoc diversity-aware multi-objective ranking framework. High novelty risk if ProteinSolver adds only noise; viable gap if orthogonal constraint satisfaction improves candidate survival.
